content.text: General
How to open an app (e.g. photos, files, email, internet, calendar, clock, schedule, et cetera.)
Click on the desired app of usage with your computer mouse/mousepad.
How to close an app
Click on the ‘x’ symbol at the top right corner of an open app window. It may prompt you to
select if you would really like to shut down the corresponding application.
Files
How to create a file
Click on the icon that is labelled ‘Files’. After that, click on the plus (+) sign. You will have the
opportunity to rename your new file to a title of your choosing.
How to delete a file
Click on the file which you desire to erase and click the delete button on your keyboard.
Quick Access Shortcuts
How to access a shortcut to access common websites of use fromt he desktop/homepage:
Shortcuts to common websites can be found on the homepage alongside all the other applications. Upon
clicking the corresponding icons, you will be automatically taken to the website.
Common Keyboard Shortcuts
Ctrl + C
Copy highlighted text or some object to the
clipboard.
Ctrl + V
Paste copied text or some object fromt he
clipboard.
Ctrl + X
Cut highlighted text, image
, or some other object.
Ctrl + S
Save the currently opened file.
Ctrl + Z
Undo the last action.
Ctrl + Y
Redo the last action.
Ctrl + A
Select all content.
Delete
Move something to the trash.
Shift + Delete
Move something permanently to trash.
Ctrl + Q
Leave an application and close it.
Ctrl + Alt + D
Minimises all the windows so that you can see
your homepage again.
PrtScr
Takes a picture of a area of your choosing on your
computer screen.
Shift + PrtScr
Takes a picture of your entire computer screen.
Apps Help
WhatsApp
How to set up a WhatsApp account/profile…

You can only setup a WhatsApp profile if you have a smartphone and a registered phone number. If you already have this, you can then login to the account following. You may send messages to those you wish by typing a phone number
Audible

Logging into Audible: Audible is owned by the company Amazon, so you will need an Amazon account to access Audible. If you already have an Amazon account, you can sign in to Audible with the email and password for that account.

Navigating audible At the top you can click “Browse”, which will show a menu with options to select from. If you have a specific book in mind, you can select the “” or “Find your next great listen” before typing out the book you would like to listen to.
Email

How to send an email Click on the pencil or ‘+’ button on the screen to draft a new email, where you may type in the email address of the person you would like to send the email to, your own email address as the sender, a subject line, and your message or any files you would like to attach.
Zoom
How to setup zooma nd operate

Click on Zoomt o start the application. If you would like to create your own meeting for others to join, click on the orange “New Meeting” button with your cursor If you would like to join a meeting hosted by someone else, click on the “Join” button with your cursor - It will prompt you to enter a meeting ID and perhaps a password as well. This information should be provided to you by the person running the online meeting

You may choose to join the meeting with your camera and audio on/off (other members will be able to see you and hear you if you choose to join with these on). You may change either of these preferences after joining the meeting as well, if at any point you do not wish to be seen or heard by others.
Words with Friends
How do I stop a game?
To resign a game, you need to open the game that you wish to resign and then press the More icon (three white horizontal lines).
Tap the "Resign" option with the white flag icon.
Confirmy our desire to resign.
Another rule is, if your opponent does not make a move soon, then the game will be automatically resigned for you.

The auto-resign times are as follows: ● Games where it’s your turn will end after 45 days. ● Games where it’s not your turn will hide fromt he ‘their move’ list after 14 days and will end after 45 days. ● This is the same for both friends and instant play opponents. ● While this will resign a game, it will also automatically create a new one. ● In this case, if the player does not want to continue playing that opponent they need to go into the new game and do the same action but click decline instead. Games that are inactive past these time limits will be auto-resigned by the game server. Resign option will only be available if it's your turn. If you are unable to resign since you're waiting for your opponent's move, but would like to remove a pending match.
Can I use any word? No. The following kinds of words are not accepted in the game: ● Proper nouns (words always capitalized). ● Abbreviations.
Prefixes and suffixes standing alone. Words requiring a hyphen or an apostrophe. Derogatory words or slurs.
How do I access the Play, Swap and Pass buttons? The Play button will appear below your game board once you have placed your tiles.
The Pass and Swap buttons can be found at the bottomo f the game board.
You can also access the Pass and Swap features through the More icon (three white horizontal lines).
Simply tap on the feature you would like to use.
Where can I find more tips and tricks? Here are some tips and tricks that will help you build a good strategy and enhance your Word Game skills in Words With Friends Instant Games!
Location, Location, Location Try playing a word on the two Double Word points bonuses within five spots of each other near the board edge. It means big points!
The Best Offense... Is a good defense! Playing a small word over a TWt ile is better than ceding it to your opponent.
How Resourceful! Hook prefixes to build existing words - PACK becomes PREPACK and JUMPS becomes OUTJUMPS.
Tongue Tied PFFT, BRRR and PSST are all valid four letter words with no vowels.
Last Tile Standing Tiles left on your rack at the end of the game count against you - make sure you get rid of themb efore you finish.
The Words 2-Step There are 101 two letter words in our dictionary! Learn as many as you can to stay nimble on the gameboard.
The C Stands Alone There are no 2 letter words with a C in them-  beware!
Tile Rack Maintenance Try keeping your rack balanced with 3 vowels and 4 consonants to keep your options open on the gameboard.
Pass it Along Feeling stumped? Sometimes passing or swapping your tiles is better than playing a poor word.
A BLANKet Observation Lucky enough to have some S and blank tiles? Use thems trategically for a big move later!
Do the Shuffle Lost on a tile rack? The pros like to shuffle their tile regularly to find hidden gems.
Best Friends Have a Q that misses its U? QAT, QANAT and SHEQEL are all valid words with no U in them.
Synergize C and H, C and K - some consonants just go well together. Keep themt ogether in your rack and watch your options grow.
7 Letter Throwdown Play all seven tiles in a single word to hit the J-A-C-K-P-O-T of 35 bonus points!
Building Blocks Look to play words that build on top of others on the board - it means more words per move.
The tile bag, located on your gameboard menu, is a helpful tool to check the odds of drawing a specific tile.
The most played words on WWF are QI, TO, RE, IT and HE.
How many active games can I have? You can have as many as 50 active games. You can also have one active game per Messenger conversation.
How many active games can I have in a group conversation? You can only have one active 1-on-1 game per group conversation. All the other players in your group conversation will be spectators.
How do I play Match Me? Clicking on Match Me will match you with another person who is not in your friends list.
A new conversation thread will be created in Messenger
Note: Your opponent does not have access to your information if you’ve set your Profile to private.
Google Chrome
Google Chrome is a web browser to access the internet. This will allow you to watch videos, find pictures, open websites, etc.
How to find something on the internet

In the search bar spanning across the length of the screen, click once with your mouse and type in the desired matter you wish to find search results for. The browser does the hard work for you, don’t worry! All you have to do is type whatever you’re looking for :)

AI overview AI overview is a helpful tool in which the search query will be summarized and provided directly in simple terms. An AI overview will be identified by a blue star, along with “AI Overview” at the beginning.
Next to some information, the overview will provide links to its sources. To view these sources, the gray oval can be clicked which will bring up a menu to the sources.
